instruction: Extract the project context, objective, actors, scope, constraints, assumptions, and missing information from the stakeholder input.
input: Project brief: CedarVale Award Review will manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions. Applicants submit application packages and approved applicants receive notices. Program Officers check submitted applications for eligibility. Eligible applications go to two Reviewers, who add comments. Finance Officers review proposed budgets after proposal reviews are complete. Award Approvers record final decisions. The brief does not specify the eligibility criteria, which role selects the two Reviewers, who revises an unacceptable budget, which channel carries an approval notice, the maximum acceptable notice time, or when applicants may first view reviewer comments.

output.business_objective: Manage grant application intake, eligibility review, proposal review, budget review, and final award decisions.

actors.name: Applicant
actors.responsibility: Submits grant application packages and receives an approval notice when applicable.
actors.source_text: Applicants submit application packages and approved applicants receive notices.

actors.name: Program Officer
actors.source_text: Program Officers check submitted applications for eligibility.

actors.name: Reviewer
actors.source_text: Eligible applications go to two Reviewers, who add comments.

actors.name: Finance Officer
actors.responsibility: Reviews proposed budgets after proposal reviews are complete.
actors.source_text: Finance Officers review proposed budgets after proposal reviews are complete.

in_scope: Routing eligible applications to two Reviewers and recording reviewer comments.
Budget review after proposal reviews are complete.
Recording final award decisions and sending notices to approved applicants.
missing_information: The criteria used to determine application eligibility.
The role responsible for selecting the two Reviewers.
The actor responsible for revising an unacceptable proposed budget.
The channel used to send an approval notice.
The maximum acceptable time for sending an approval notice.
When applicants may first view reviewer comments.

instruction: Assess and refine the stakeholder requirement without inventing missing values, actors, technologies, or constraints.
input: Award Approver request: Once an application is approved, the applicant should get a notice quickly through some suitable channel.

output.original_requirement: Once an application is approved, the applicant should get a notice quickly through some suitable channel.

issues.description: The word quickly does not define a verifiable maximum delivery time.

clarification_questions: What is the maximum acceptable time for sending an approval notice?
